cohort: Live term singleton births in Brazil from 2004 to 2009
finding: Maternal education level is clearly associated with the risk of a low 5-minute Apgar score, with a lower risk observed in mothers with higher levels of education.
mod_finding: Mothers who gave birth by cesarean section did not have an increased risk of a low 5-minute Apgar score (OR 1.0 [95% confidence interval 0.9-1.2]).
